verses.1: Do not become many teachers, brothers, knowing that we will suffer greater punishment.
verses.2: After all, we all fall short of perfection. If someone fails to do this in their speech, then he is a complete man; he is capable of achieving great things and shaping his entire body accordingly.
verses.3: And if we put those horses’ mouths into their mouths, so that they will obey us, then we can also control their entire bodies.
verses.4: And also the ships, which are shaped like that, and are being blown about by strong winds. They are carried along by the strong currents of wind, wherever the direction of the wind desires them to go.
verses.5: Similarly, language is also a small part of reality, yet it has great importance. Look: a small fire can create something truly wonderful.
verses.6: And the language of fire… the world of injustice becomes the language that fills our hearts. It consumes everything in its path, and it causes the wheels of fate to turn in a direction that is harmful.
verses.7: For every creature, whether it be wild animals, birds, or other animals, they are all subject to the laws of nature.
verses.8: No one can control a person’s language. It is a source of great harm, and even more so, it can be deadly.
verses.9: In her, we praise the Lord and Father. In her, we honor those people who have become like God in their nature.
verses.10: From its mouth, holiness and evilness both emanate. Do not let this happen, my brothers.
verses.11: Or does the source from that same source produce both sweet and bitter substances?
verses.12: I cannot, my brothers, make wine or make it into a kind of drink that’s sweet. Nor can I turn water into something sweet.
verses.13: What are the wise and profound teachings among you? Let us see how He accomplishes His works through this wonderful transformation in the midst of wisdom.
verses.14: But if you have a bitter desire in your heart, and if there is malice in your soul, then do not pretend to be honest or truthful.
verses.15: It’s not a wisdom that comes from above; rather, it’s a kind of spiritual, demonic wisdom.
verses.16: For where there is greed and selfishness, there will be chaos and all kinds of evil things.
verses.17: But that higher form of wisdom is first and foremost pure and innocent. It also involves peacefulness, generosity, trustworthiness, and the pursuit of good deeds. It’s also characterized by honesty and integrity.
verses.18: But the seeds of justice are sown among those who practice peace.
